Apple (AAPL) Stock Rating Lowered by BidaskClub Posted by Anthony Miller | Feb 20th, 2018 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was downgraded by research analysts at BidaskClub from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research note issued to investors on Friday, January 26th. 
Several other analysts also recently weighed in on AAPL. Deutsche Bank reaffirmed a “hold” rating and issued a $140.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, September 28th. Royal Bank of Canada reissued an “outperform” rating and set a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, October 3rd. Robert W. Baird reissued a “buy” rating and set a $175.00 price objective (up previously from $172.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 4th. Vetr downgraded shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $173.47 price objective on the stock. in a report on Friday, October 6th. Finally, UBS Group reissued a “buy” rating and set a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 9th. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-three have issued a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company. The company presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $201.64. Get Apple alerts: 
Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) traded down $0.58 during midday trading on Friday, reaching $171.85. 33,688,530 shares of the company’s stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 41,970,000. The firm has a market capitalization of $871,970.00, a price-to-earnings ratio of 16.82, a PEG ratio of 1.30 and a beta of 1.33. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple has a one year low of $135.10 and a one year high of $180.10. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm earned $3.36 earnings per share. research analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.46 EPS for the current year. 
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Thursday, December 7th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.69, for a total value of $2,654,121.29. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 17,341 shares in the company, valued at $2,942,594.29. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through this link . Also, SVP Johny Srouji sold 5,760 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, November 22nd. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.40, for a total transaction of $1,004,544.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 81,560 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $14,224,064. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last 90 days, insiders have sold 112,771 shares of company stock valued at $19,419,429. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock. 
Institutional investors and hedge funds have recently made changes to their positions in the business. CNB Bank purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the fourth quarter worth approximately $1,455,000. BRITISH COLUMBIA INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT Corp lifted its position in shares of Apple by 3.6% in the fourth quarter. BRITISH COLUMBIA INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT Corp now owns 2,479,006 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $419,522,000 after purchasing an additional 85,919 shares in the last quarter. Intercontinental Wealth Advisors LLC lifted its position in shares of Apple by 12.4% in the fourth quarter. Intercontinental Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 9,362 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,584,000 after purchasing an additional 1,035 shares in the last quarter. Pin Oak Investment Advisors Inc. purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the fourth quarter worth approximately $1,720,000. Finally, Tuttle Tactical Management LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the fourth quarter worth approximately $1,440,000. Institutional investors own 59.70% of the company’s stock.
